facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Law of October 2021 generally requires personal data to be stored in Rwanda unless the supervisory authority grants a certificate.
facts.system: Law Relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority fined MTN Rwanda FRW 7.03 billion in May 2017 for hosting its IT services outside the country.
